name: Temporary Residence by Investment

requirements.blocker_text: At least EUR 50,000 in funds held in a non-resident bank account in Serbia, intended for investment in a registered legal entity's tangible/intangible assets or business activity.
requirements.fix_path: Deposit at least EUR 50,000 in a non-resident Serbian bank account earmarked for the investment.

requirements.blocker_text: At least EUR 5,000 contributed in cash to the company's share capital to qualify for the 1-year extension.
requirements.fix_path: Contribute at least EUR 5,000 to the company's registered share capital.

outcome.duration_length: 6 months initially; extendable to 1 year on meeting the capital-contribution condition

sources.title: Welcome to Serbia (welcometoserbia.org -- a private relocation-consultancy site, NOT the official welcometoserbia.gov.rs government portal despite the similar name): investor residence permit, EUR 50,000 initial non-resident account funds, EUR 5,000 capital-contribution extension, 6-month initial / 1-year extended duration
